description: Flat metadata schema for individual marine microbiome sequencing records collected from water, sediment, and marine organism-associated samples across oceanic regions.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample or sequencing record.

sample_name.descr: Human-readable sample name or code used in the project.

sampling_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sampling_time.descr: Local or UTC collection time if available, preferably ISO 8601 (HH:MM:SS).

latitude.descr: Sampling latitude in decimal degrees north (negative for south).

longitude.descr: Sampling longitude in decimal degrees east (negative for west).

ocean_region.descr: Named oceanic region or basin, for example North Atlantic, South Pacific, Arctic Ocean.

site_name.descr: Specific station, cruise site, reef, transect, or sampling location name.

country_or_territory.descr: Country, territory, or jurisdiction associated with the sampling location if applicable.

environment_type.descr: Broad environment category such as marine, estuarine, coastal, open_ocean, deep_sea.

sample_matrix.descr: Primary material sampled; controlled values such as water, sediment, organism_surface, organism_gut, organism_tissue, biofilm.

host_organism.descr: Taxonomic or common name of the marine organism for host-associated microbiome samples; blank or NA for non-host samples.

host_taxon_id.descr: Stable taxonomic identifier for the host organism if available, such as NCBI Taxonomy ID or other authority ID.

host_life_stage.descr: Life stage of the host organism when relevant, such as larva, juvenile, adult.

water_column_zone.descr: Water-column context such as surface, epipelagic, mesopelagic, bathypelagic, abyssopelagic, benthic.

sampling_depth_m.descr: Sampling depth in meters below surface or seabed, depending on context; use numeric values.

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature in degrees Celsius at sampling time.

salinity_psu.descr: Practical salinity units (PSU) measured at sampling time.

pH.descr: Measured pH of the sampled environment or overlying water.

turbidity_ntu.descr: Turbidity in nephelometric turbidity units (NTU) if measured.

chlorophyll_a_ug_L.descr: Chlorophyll a concentration in micrograms per liter if measured.

nitrate_umol_L.descr: Nitrate concentration in micromoles per liter if measured.

phosphate_umol_L.descr: Phosphate concentration in micromoles per liter if measured.

silicate_umol_L.descr: Silicate concentration in micromoles per liter if measured.

conductivity_mS_cm.descr: Conductivity of the sample water in mS/cm if measured.

pressure_dbar.descr: Ambient pressure at sampling depth in decibars if measured.

sampling_instrument.descr: Instrument or device used to collect the sample, for example Niskin bottle, grab sampler, corer, net, swab.

collection_protocol.descr: Brief description or reference for the sampling protocol used.

sample_volume_L.descr: Volume of water collected in liters; use for water samples when applicable.

sample_mass_g.descr: Mass of sediment or tissue collected in grams; use when applicable.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size in micrometers for water filtration-based sampling, if applicable.

fraction_size_fraction.descr: Target size fraction or mesh size used for filtration or sieving, if applicable.

preservation_method.descr: How the sample was preserved after collection, such as flash-frozen, RNAlater, ethanol, dry ice, liquid nitrogen.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature in degrees Celsius prior to nucleic acid extraction.

time_to_processing_hr.descr: Time from collection to extraction or stabilization in hours.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used.

rna_extraction_method.descr: RNA extraction kit or protocol used, if RNA was extracted.

nucleic_acid_type.descr: Type of nucleic acid sequenced or prepared, such as DNA, RNA, cDNA, metagenome, metatranscriptome.

input_amount_ng.descr: Amount of nucleic acid input used for library preparation in nanograms.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used.

amplicon_target_region.descr: Targeted marker region if amplicon sequencing was performed, for example 16S rRNA V4, 18S, ITS.

primer_forward.descr: Forward primer sequence or identifier used for amplicon generation.

primer_reverse.descr: Reverse primer sequence or identifier used for amplicon generation.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used, such as Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, PacBio, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_instrument_model.descr: Specific instrument model used, if known.

read_layout.descr: Sequencing layout such as single-end, paired-end, or long-read.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs for each read end or average long-read length.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Run identifier or accession for the sequencing run.

barcode_index.descr: Sample barcode or index sequence/identifier used for multiplexing.

library_layout.descr: Library orientation or strategy such as shotgun, amplicon, stranded RNA-seq.

sequencing_center.descr: Facility or laboratory where sequencing was performed.

bioinformatics_pipeline.descr: Name or version of the primary processing pipeline used for downstream analysis.

reference_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic or functional assignment, if applicable.

analysis_target.descr: Primary analysis focus such as taxonomic profiling, functional potential, metagenomics, metatranscriptomics.

qc_passed.descr: Indicates whether the record passed quality-control filtering.

contamination_screened.descr: Indicates whether contamination screening was performed.

replicate_type.descr: Replicate category such as biological, technical, or none.

replicate_id.descr: Identifier linking technical or biological replicates from the same sample group.

associated_bioproject.descr: Project accession or registry identifier associated with the sample, if available.

associated_biosample.descr: BioSample or equivalent sample accession identifier, if available.

associated_sra_run.descr: Sequence Read Archive run accession or equivalent raw-read identifier, if available.
